metadata.value:
Numbers are your thing. You know your way around financial statements. And when something doesn’t add up, you’re the person who wants to find out why.
We’re looking for a versatile, hands-on accountant who can take ownership, work independently, and keep things moving even when priorities change. You’ll be responsible for financial statements and accounting activities across multiple companies, while also helping solve unexpected challenges that come with the job.
If that sounds like something you're passionate about, apply now!

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:

- Independently prepare corporate income tax calculations and ensure timely preparation and submission of related tax payments and documentation.
- Prepare and submit statistical reports and VAT returns, as well as support other tax and regulatory reporting requirements.
- Maintain and reconcile balance sheet, general ledger, and sub-ledger accounts, including intercompany, supplier, and customer accounts.
- Prepare and maintain documentation and supporting files for monthly and year-end reporting.
- Prepare data and documentation for set-off agreements, dividend resolutions, and other corporate accounting matters.
- Actively participate in local and group audit processes, including preparing financial statements, reports, and supporting documentation.
- Monitor accounting and tax obligations, identify process-related risks and opportunities, and propose practical solutions and improvements.
- Contribute to improving accounting processes, tools, and ways of working to increase efficiency, accuracy, and quality.

independently while being a reliable team player.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, solution-oriented mindset.
- Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- A strong sense of ownership and responsibility for your work, with the confidence to take initiative and make things happen.
- A collaborative mindset and willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues, and learn from others.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and Slovenian.
- A high level of integrity and discretion, particularly when handling confidential and sensitive financial information.
- Strong accounting expertise, with solid knowledge of financial reporting, taxation and accounting principles, and the ability to independently apply this knowledge in practice.

- Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central would be advantageous.

metadata.name: Publish - Description (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
The team
The analytics team turns complex player, game, and market data into actionable insight and predictive capabilities across Outfit7’s Talking Tom and Friends mobile game portfolio. Spanning product analytics, data science, and marketing intelligence, the team works across the entire game lifecycle, from early prototype validation and soft launch testing to live-ops optimization. It analyses game related data, while partnering closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Production, and Leadership to support evidence-based decisions, build reliable forecasting models, and ensure robust data infrastructure.

The role
As Head of Analytics, you will support the strategic use of data across Outfit7's game portfolio. Managing through direct team leads who oversee daily operations, your core focus will be on innovation, high-value data research, and aligning analytics directly with division goals.
You will oversee product performance and core KPIs, uncover growth opportunities through exploratory research, and partner closely with marketing on campaign optimization and LTV forecasting. You will lead the evolution of Outfit7 analytical workflows, shifting the organization away from ad-hoc reporting toward a dashboard-first, self-serve approach that empowers product and growth teams with real-time insight and allows data scientists to focus on research.

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Lead the analytics team by setting clear expectations, providing actionable feedback, and fostering an environment of accountability.
- Shape the team’s organizational structure and hiring priorities, driving succession planning and long-term career development for team leads and senior specialists.
- Develop analytics and data science roadmap, aligning technical priorities directly with division goals and product roadmaps.
- Drive proactive research projects that identify gameplay and commercial opportunities.
- Oversee product performance tracking and core KPIs, helping Product and Production teams make data-backed calls on feature updates, live-ops, and game economies.
- Partner with Growth and Marketing on campaign performance, attribution, and predictive LTV models to guide acquisition spend.
- Transition the company from reactive, manual reporting to a dashboard-first, self-serve model so product teams get instant answers and data scientists can focus on research.
- Define testing and validation criteria for prototypes and soft launches to advise leadership on whether to scale, pivot, or kill concepts early.
- Flag emerging portfolio trends, drop-offs, and commercial risks, providing clear recommendations directly to executive management.
- Ensure data definitions, measurement methodologies, and tracking standards remain clean and consistent across the studio.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Skills (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Strong leadership skills. 
- Strong practical foundation in product analytics, covering core KPI tracking, player segmentation, economy balancing, and rigorous A/B testing methodologies.
- Solid grasp of applied data science in gaming.
- Deep hands-on experience with marketing analytics, including predictive LTV modeling, ROAS optimization, UA channel performance, and incrementality/media mix evaluation.
- Practical familiarity with modern data stacks, clean telemetry practices, and leveraging AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows.
- Hands-on SQL, Python or R 
- Ability to translate complex data into practical context and discuss trade-offs directly with Product Leads, UA Leads, Producers, and Leadership.
- Strong communication skills, with fluency in the English language (both written and spoken).

metadata.name: Publish - Required Experience (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- 7+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, or business intelligence, with significant background in mobile gaming or high-scale mobile apps.
- Balanced end-to-end expertise across both product data (in-game data, economies, live-ops) and marketing data (UA performance, attribution, media efficiency).
- Experience leading through team managers or senior specialists.
- Strong track record of finding commercial and gameplay opportunities through data, driving tangible impact on retention, monetization, and acquisition.
- Proven track record of transitioning organizations to a dashboard-first, self-serve data model (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Lightdash, or custom tools) to eliminate ad-hoc reporting bottlenecks.

metadata.name: Publish - Description (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
We are looking for an adaptable and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join the Ad Mediation Analytics team. In this role, you will be responsible for ad mediation experimentation and design algorithms that power ad monetization across games played by millions.
You will collaborate closely with ad ops, platform engineering, data and analytics engineers, and game teams to turn complex ad mediation data into high-yield  initiatives using optimization techniques and machine learning. From designing floor-pricing algorithms and automatic ad mediation waterfall generation to developing self-serve data products, running tests.
We value clear thinking and communication, drive, curiosity and empirical rigor. If you are eager to tackle non-trivial challenges and inform impactful decisions in a collaborative, results-oriented environment, we would love to hear from you.

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Design, optimize and test data-driven mediation algorithms. Leveraging optimization techniques and machine learning, you will segment users, automate segment-specific waterfall generation and floor-pricing strategies. 
- Architect end-to-end analytical solutions: provide ad event schemas, partner with analytics engineers to build high-reliability data modeling pipelines, dashboards and self-serve diagnostic tools that power rapid monetization decision-making.
- Be responsible for experimentation across the mediation stack to evaluate and optimise ad mediation performance. Propose, design, and deploy A/B tests and other testing methodologies and evaluate their results.
- Conduct deep-dive exploratory analysis and root-cause performance attribution to uncover optimization opportunities, explain performance shifts, and diagnose mediation anomalies.
- Translate complex findings into insights that clearly articulate the business impact of mediation models, support ad mediation roadmaps, and executive leadership on monetization strategy.
- Foster cross-functional collaboration across ad platform development, ad operations, data engineering, business and game development and support evidence-based decision-making.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Skills (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Proven track record of applying statistical and ML techniques pragmatically. Prioritizing projects and solutions with clear business impact, interpretability, and low operational overhead over unnecessary model complexity.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and ability to interpret datasets, identify patterns, and provide actionable business insights.
- High technical autonomy and proven ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into well-defined problem formulation and independently drive projects.
- Strong written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to translate complex statistical concepts and ad mediation dynamics into structured summaries for technical peers and leadership.
- Active experience leveraging AI/LLM tools to accelerate analytic workflows.
- Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to support product and monetization decisions by defending empirical findings constructively.
- Expert proficiency in SQL and cloud-based data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake), and R or Python for data analysis, visualization, and statistical modeling.
- Proficiency in production software best practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing, and modular, maintainable, clean code.
- Solid business oriented mind set and strong product sense.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Experience (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- 5+ years of experience as a data scientist, with a strong preference for experience in ad tech (ad mediation platforms and algorithms) and/or ad monetization in mobile games.
- Proven experience designing and deploying machine learning and optimization algorithms preferably in ad tech.
- Hands-on experience working with modern analytics engineering tools (dbt, Airflow) building dashboards (e.g., Shiny, Lightdash, Tableau) and internal data tools like bidding simulators and automated anomaly-detection.
- Deep expertise in experimental design (user-level A/B testing, and causal inference) and automating statistical evaluation workflows.

metadata.value:
You’re a gamer yourself, and you know when art makes a game feel more exciting, satisfying, and alive. You care about more than how assets look in isolation: you make sure they work in the game and support the player experience.
You’re a versatile game artist with a strong VFX background. You understand how timing, shape, color, and motion can bring gameplay to life, and you’re confident working in Unity, using shader workflows, and opening code to understand how things work. You balance visual impact with clarity, performance, and the realities of production.
You bring a generalist perspective to the art pipeline, contribute practical art and art-tech guidance, and help turn early ideas into playable results. You challenge assumptions, iterate quickly, and polish with purpose.
Sound like you? Then apply now and let’s work on awesome games together.

metadata.name: Publish - Responsibilities (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- Contribute across the art pipeline, bringing a generalist perspective and hands-on support where the game needs it most.
- Create and implement game art, with a focus on visual effects that make gameplay feel more responsive, exciting, and clear.
- Help shape features from early ideation and concepts through prototypes, mockups, and in-engine implementation, working with art direction, design, and engineering.
- Provide art and art-tech guidance across production, helping teams turn the game’s vision into practical, achievable work.
- Identify risks, blockers, and opportunities in art production, and find solutions that improve quality, iteration, and scalability.
- Help define priorities, scope, and workflows so the team can deliver functional, playable work with polish that serves the game.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Skills (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- A versatile game art generalist with a strong VFX background and a portfolio showing readable, effective effects in gameplay.
- Deep knowledge in at least two art disciplines, with the ability to give useful art and art-tech input across teams.
- Professional proficiency in Unity, including confidence implementing and iterating on work in-engine.
- Comfort opening and reading code to understand how systems work, troubleshoot issues, and make or support straightforward changes.
- Practical shader experience and an understanding of how materials, shaders, and real-time effects work together.
- A strong game artist mindset: you consider timing, shape, color, motion, gameplay, camera, readability, performance, and how your work fits into the wider game.
- A pragmatic approach to scope and craft: you challenge initial assumptions, evaluate different options, and polish with purpose.
- Experience sharing knowledge, guiding or mentoring artists, and helping improve team workflows.

metadata.name: Publish - Required Experience (Recruiter)
metadata.value:
- 5+ years of experience in game development, creating and implementing art for games.
- 3+ years of professional experience with real-time VFX, including building effects and working with shaders in Unity. Your portfolio or reel shows polished, readable effects in an interactive context.
- Hands-on experience with Unity or a proprietary C++ game engine, including implementing art in-engine and working with particle systems, materials, shaders, or similar tools.
- Experience contributing across the art pipeline, such as prototyping features, collaborating with other disciplines, or providing art and art-tech input.
- Experience with procedural tools or node-based shader workflows is a plus.
